about: The epithet lexicon for the label marker (src/core/discourse/labels.js, project-docs/ARGUMENT-LENS.md). A head is an epithet that can name a person; a modifier makes an epithet compound ("radical-left lunatic") and counts toward severity only on a head; an intensifier may sit between without counting. aim says which side an entry is usually aimed at: it exists for the balance test and is never shipped to the rule (scripts/labels-data.mjs drops it). Every aimed entry names its mirror on the other side. institutions are capitalised words that, right after an epithet, mark a proper-noun or historical use ("Communist Party"), not a person. source is the word's dictionary entry; why is the reason it is in the list.
